item.title: Version 0.8.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Mark Wallpaper Library entries with a yellow bookmark and filter the library down to them
  • Pro: like Workshop items with the pink heart, then turn on Liked in the filter bar to list them

Improvements

  • The welcome tour is now a set of spotlight guides you can dismiss at any step
  • Saved becomes Schemes and holds saved display setups only; bookmarks moved into the Wallpaper Library
  • Pro: the Steam account menu is a glass capsule

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: unliking a Workshop item no longer deletes its saved scenes
  • Pro: attached scene layers keep their offset, and Gaussian blurs and multiply blending over transparent areas render correctly again
  • Pro: effect histories no longer leak between layers, and scenes that declare the same history buffer twice load
  • Very long log lines no longer slow down bug reports
  • Pro: scene parallax matches Windows — layers without a set depth follow the pointer, and a group moves as one
  • Pro: cursor-following iris and depth-parallax effects line up with their layer again
  • Pro: more scene shaders compile, and vertical Gaussian blurs no longer blur sideways
  • Pro: layers pinned to a puppet bone inside a group follow the bone
  • A welcome tour finished in 0.8.0 stays finished
  • Unreadable saved bookmarks are reported, with a Reset for just that file

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
